name: F.P. Journe Tourbillon Souverain à Remontoire d'Égalité
description: The F.P. Journe Tourbillon Souverain à Remontoire d’Egalité is known for its pioneering mechanical innovations, including a constant force device (remontoir d’égalité) designed for enhanced timekeeping accuracy. This mechanism ensures that energy from the mainspring is consistently delivered to the escapement, reducing variations in timekeeping as the watch unwinds. Additionally, the watch features a "dead seconds" complication (seconde morte), where the seconds hand remains stationary until each second has passed, an uncommon feature that provides precise time indication and highlights F.P. Journe's commitment to horological precision.

name: Blancpain Carrousel Répétition Minutes
description: This grand complication is the premiere in the history of watchmaking, combining a one-minute flying carrousel and a minute repeater with cathedral chimes. One-minute flying carrousel Designed to counteract the perturbations induced by gravity on the accuracy of watches, the carrousel is a rare and fascinating complication. Blancpain has revived this device and incorporated it into a wristwatch for the first time.

description: Révélation d'une Panthère watch, 37 mm, mechanical movement with manual winding, caliber 430 MC. name: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Selfwinding 34mm
description: A timeless masterpiece, the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Selfwinding 34mm features a stunning octagonal bezel, intricate dial, and impeccable craftsmanship, embodying luxury and elegance.

name: Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar 43mm
description: The Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar combines nautical inspiration with precise mechanics. It features an annual calendar complication, requiring adjustment only once a year, and is powered by the in-house UN-113 movement. With a classic marine chronometer design, it includes a power reserve indicator, small seconds at 6 o'clock, and a large date display. Its 43mm case is available in stainless steel or rose gold, maintaining the brand's heritage of creating robust, maritime-inspired timepieces.

name: A. Lange & Söhne DATOGRAPH PERPETUAL TOURBILLON HONEYGOLD
description: The DATOGRAPH PERPETUAL TOURBILLON HONEYGOLD “Lumen” unites three significant complications in a case made of 18-carat HONEYGOLD®: a flyback chronograph, a perpetual calendar and a tourbillon with a stop-seconds mechanism. Furthermore, all displays are luminous. The model version in 18-carat HONEYGOLD® features a semi-transparent dial made of sapphire crystal and is limited to 50 pieces.
